description: Fetches a URL in a rendered browser and extracts structured JSON matching a caller-supplied JSON Schema in one call, using AI with multi-model fallback. Cached for 24 hours per URL and schema. For text already in hand, /extract costs less. Costs $0.021 per call via x402.

prompt.description: Optional natural-language guidance on what to extract and where it appears.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the desired output structure.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to extract data from.

name: tariffmonkee-extract-url
